تضطغني (form VIII)

# تُضْطَغَنِي (tuḍṭaḡanī) /tudˤ.tˤa.ɣa.niː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَغَنَ (iḍṭaḡana)
